chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from al-Washsha', from Aban, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi 'Abd Allah, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

A Christian woman or a Jewish woman may be under a Muslim man, and then her child is falsely accused [of illegitimacy]. He عليه السلام said: “He is to be given the hadd punishment, because the Muslim has made her muhsanah.”

key_terms.حَصَّنَهَا: he rendered her protected/chaste through marriage
key_terms.فَيُقْذَفُ: is falsely accused with slander of illicit lineage

ai.seo_question: Does the hadd for qadhf apply if someone accuses the child of a Christian or Jewish wife of a Muslim man?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding false accusation against the child of a Christian or Jewish woman who is married to a Muslim man. The Imam عليه السلام states that the hadd punishment applies, because her marriage to the Muslim grants her the protected status relevant to this ruling.
